facts.fact: Lilongwe City Council's policy statement says it will deploy a computerized property information management system for billing and collection of property rates, under a land-based revenue modernization activity covering four cities of Malawi; it is a plan, not a live system.

Lilongwe City Council's policy statement says the United States has agreed to provide US$24 million in grant funding under the Millennium Challenge second compact to finance the land-based revenue modernization activity in four cities, including digital mapping, automated property records and a computerized billing system.

systems.system: Lilongwe City Council property rates information management system (existing)
systems.tiers: Lilongwe City; described only as outdated and not integrated with land management or payment platforms
